title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Customer Contract Rank for Surcharge Purposes
content:
## Clause

For the Dangerous Goods Acceptance loading surcharge, the customer is given a contract rank taken from the tier of its service contract in active status. A customer without an active service contract has rank 0. Contracts that have expired, are suspended, have been terminated or were never signed give no rank.

## Rank by contract tier

| Tier of the active service contract | Rank |
|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 1 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 2 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 3 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 4 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 5 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 6 |
| no active service contract | 0 |

## Cases

| Customer's service contracts | Rank |
|---|---|
| one AHL Global Account Contract, active | 5 |
| one AHL Strategic Partner Contract, expired | 0 |
| one AHL Key Account Contract, suspended | 0 |
| none | 0 |

## Point of judgement

**The customer's contract is awaiting signature.** An unsigned contract gives no rank, so the rank is 0.
